selection.why: always included; PG-* page task (component, page, UI)
business logic: case-type defaults applied at case creation (domain resolver, router precedence); the task's STOA is domain
keywords test / coverage / a11y: TDD suites, diff coverage, axe + WCAG review
keyword permission: admin-only mutations (RBAC), tenant isolation, a migration with RLS

not_selected.why: no AI, ML or embedding change
no CI, CD, pipeline or Docker change

baseline_note: Root 'pnpm run build' (turbo build of every app) is not run here: ~12 GB free on C:, and three lanes share the machine. The build of every touched package plus apps/web is matrix row 11; the full build runs in the runner's pre-ship at the final SHA.
